decision_rules: Judge the TARGET fragment only; the context helps you understand it but is not coded.
Choose the single category the fragment MAINLY addresses; if two apply, choose the one most of the text is about.

A fragment about AI in general (economy, industry, defence) that says nothing about education, training or learning is 'none' unless it is about governance or ethics of AI that the text applies to education.
